name: Test Delegation to K8s Pods
description: Quick validation of acp_delegate with devbob pods in Kubernetes

task_steps.description: Test basic delegation to devbob-0 pod

prompt.template:
Test basic acp_delegate to K8s devbob pod.

Task: Delegate a simple task to devbob-0 pod in metabob namespace.

Use acp_delegate tool:
```typescript
acp_delegate({
  target: "docker://devbob-0",
  taskDescription: "Test basic delegation",
  prompt: "Please respond with: 'Delegation test successful from [your-hostname]'. Use the 'bash' tool to run 'hostname' command to get your hostname.",
  timeout: 60
})
```

Expected result:
- Connection established
- Remote agent responds with hostname
- Duration < 30 seconds

If this fails, the acp_delegate tool may need updates to support kubectl exec for K8s pods.

Report:
- Success/failure status
- Response from remote pod
- Duration
- Any errors
